meta.title: MeshBridge — Private device mesh and large-file transfer
meta.description: MeshBridge joins your devices into a private WireGuard mesh and moves large files directly between them — resumable, verified, never through a third party.

tun.title: New tunnel
tun.sub: Give an intranet web page a public, key-protected link.

tun.sandboxHint: Path-mode links share the site origin; sandboxing blocks tunneled pages from reading this console's data.

portal.title: A place for every project.
portal.lede: Read, write, build and explore. Every project is its own space, and one MineAI account opens them all.
portal.folio: Document libraries, grounded answers and knowledge graphs.
portal.inkwell: Books, chapters and a patient writing companion.
portal.parley: Custom assistants, conversations and AI tutoring.
portal.codebench: Coding sessions, terminals and your own runners.
portal.echo: A diary, personal reflections and interactive stories.
portal.hearthvale: Build a village and guide its settlers through the seasons.
portal.toolshed: Scan, convert and share files from your browser.
portal.meshbridge: Private device connections and access to your intranet services.
portal.projectsSub: Each one opens on its own address and keeps its own data.
portal.p1Body: Sign in once with your MineAI account. Projects recognise you without asking for another password.
portal.p2Body: Every project has its own address, data and roles. Nothing is shared unless you choose to share it.
portal.p3Body: The project menu in every project brings you back here, or on to the next one.

gset.title: Google sign-in
gset.desc: Lets people sign in to MineAI and MeshBridge with a Google account, next to their password.
gset.srcSettings: Saved here. A change applies to the next sign-in page — no restart needed.
gset.srcEnv: Set by the server environment (MESH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID). Saving a value here overrides it at once; changing the environment value needs a service restart.
gset.srcDisabled: Turned off here. The environment value is ignored until you save a client ID again.
gset.srcNone: Not configured. The Google button stays hidden; password sign-in is unaffected.
gset.origins: Authorized JavaScript origins to add in Google Cloud
gset.originsHint: Add each of these origins to the OAuth client in Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials). Google rejects sign-in from an origin that isn't listed.
